items.title: 2.6.1.1 Creating, Accessing, and Modifying Lists (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of creating lists (PDF 50-51).

blocks.text: List square brackets ke andar commas se alag cheezein rakh kar banti hai. List mein mukhtalif qism ki cheezein ho sakti hain: adad, strings ya doosri lists bhi.

blocks.prompt: Agar "Apple" aur "Banana" ke darmiyan comma chhoot jaye, jaise kitab ke chhape code mein, to kya hoga?
blocks.explanation: Python saath likhi do strings jor deti hai, to list mein do cheezein hongi, 'Mango' aur 'AppleBanana'.

items: List [item, item, ...] se banayein; cheezein kisi bhi qism ki ho sakti hain.
